title: OmniCraft security exception ledger entry
description: Machine-readable exception ledger for security scan findings. Secret findings and release Critical vulnerabilities are non-waivable; only High findings may be recorded here, each requiring an independent human approver and a commit-bound approval reference. In a single-human-owner repository no High exception can pass (see security/scan-policy.json).

affected_version.description: Exact affected version, or a version range string from the scan report

severity.description: Only High is waivable; secret/critical findings are non-waivable

approver.description: GitHub login of an independent human approver; must differ from author

approval_ref.description: Immutable reference binding the approval to a concrete commit plus a GitHub PR review or protected-environment approval event. An issue/comment URL alone is mutable and insufficient.
